title: Fix Wgpu Window Options Chip Z-Order
description: Fix folded Window Options and Command chip buttons in the wgpu renderer so they render below glassy side panels. Root cause: folded chips are drawn to the overlay draw list backdrop tier, which composites on top of side panel glass. Fix: render chips to the main draw list instead, matching unfolded rails.
summary:
Fixed folded Window Options and Command chips rendering above glassy side panels in the wgpu renderer.

Root cause: folded chips were drawn to the overlay draw list's backdrop tier. In `composite_to_swapchain`, overlay backdrop always composites after overlay glass, so chips painted on top of side panels.

Fix: render both folded chips unconditionally to the main `draw` list (matching unfolded rails that already use `draw.push_glass(..., GlassTier::WindowOptions)`). Side panels remain on `overlay` and composite after `draw`.

`cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu` blocked by pre-existing `semio-framework-plugin` compile errors (unrelated `world3d_scene_extended` signature). Change is a two-line draw-list target swap with no new API.
